# M5: Hardening and deploy-readiness

Branch `feat/m5-hardening`, worktree `../nt-m5`. Read `STATUS.md` first.
Migration file (if needed): `supabase/migrations/20261120000200_hardening.sql`.

## Goal

Make NeuroTrack safe and ready to ship. **Do not deploy anything, create cloud resources or touch
the hosted database.** Prepare everything so that deploying is a short, documented set of steps.

M2, M3 and M4 are being built in parallel. Keep your edits away from their folders:
`src/app/(app)/neuro|behaviour|research`, `api/app/behaviour|research`, and their `src/lib`
modules.

## Checklist

### API hardening (`api/app/`)
- [x] `middleware.py`:
  - Per-client rate limiting: an in-memory token bucket keyed by the JWT `sub` claim when there
    is one, otherwise by client IP. Use stricter limits for `/quantum/*` and `/research/*`, and
    configure them through `Settings`. Return **429** with a `Retry-After` header.
  - A request body size limit (for example 2 MB, configurable) returning **413**.
  - Security headers.
  - A request ID, and structured JSON access logs. Log no bodies and no tokens.
- [x] Register the middleware in `main.py` with as few lines as possible.
- [x] A global exception handler that never leaks stack traces.
- [x] `ALLOWED_HOSTS` through `TrustedHostMiddleware`, configurable, with a permissive default
      in development.
- [x] Pytest:
  - 429 after the burst.
  - `Retry-After` is present.
  - 413 on an oversized body.
  - Headers are present.
  - The rate-limit key uses `sub`.

### Web hardening
- [ ] In `next.config.ts`, security headers on all routes:
  - HSTS (production only), `X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`
    and `frame-ancestors 'none'`.
  - A Content-Security-Policy that works with Next 16, Supabase (`connect-src` to the project
    URL taken from the env at build time) and WebGL/three.js (no `unsafe-eval` in production).

  Read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for the Next 16 way to do this.
- [ ] Add `error.tsx` and `not-found.tsx` for the `(app)` group and globally, `global-error.tsx`,
      and `loading.tsx` skeletons for `(app)`.
- [ ] `/settings` page:
  - Edit the display name. Only `display_name` is user-updatable; the RLS already restricts this.
  - "Delete all my experiment history", with a confirmation step.
  - "Download my data" as a JSON export of the user's own profile and experiments.
- [ ] Add `/privacy` and `/terms` pages, linked from the landing-page footer. **Footer link only;
      do not otherwise redesign the landing page.**

### Privacy and RLS verification
- [ ] `e2e/privacy.spec.ts` (gated on `E2E_USER_EMAIL`/`PASSWORD` and `E2E_USER2_EMAIL`/`PASSWORD`,
      added to `.env.example`). Two users sign in through `@supabase/supabase-js` directly and
      check that:
  - User B cannot select, update or delete user A's `experiments` or `profiles`.
  - Neither user can change their own `role`.

  **Do not run it.**
- [ ] `supabase/tests/rls_checklist.md`: a table of every table across M0–M4 (M3 and M4 are being
      written in parallel; read their briefs in `docs/build/`) and its intended policies, for
      review at integration.

### Deploy-readiness (prepare, do not deploy)
- [ ] `api/Dockerfile`:
  - Multi-stage, based on `python:3.12-slim` with `uv`.
  - Installs from `uv.lock` with `--no-dev`.
  - Non-root user.
  - Runs `uvicorn` on `$PORT` with workers configurable.
  - Has a healthcheck.
- [ ] `api/.dockerignore`.
- [ ] Verify `docker build` is not required locally; Docker is not installed here. Instead, add a
      CI job that builds the image (no push).
- [ ] `render.yaml`, a Render blueprint for the API, as one documented option. Free-tier sleep
      and memory are caveats: **write "check current limits" instead of quoting numbers you
      cannot verify.**
- [ ] `docs/deploy.md`, step by step:
  - Supabase: applying migrations, configuring auth URLs and redirect URLs, and email
    templates.
  - Vercel for the web app, with the env var table.
  - The API on Render or Hugging Face Spaces (Docker) or Fly.io, with `NEUROTRACK_API_URL` and
    a rollback note.
  - A post-deploy smoke test.
- [ ] `.github/dependabot.yml` (npm, uv/pip, github-actions; weekly).
- [ ] A CI `security` job that runs `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` and `uv run pip-audit`.
      If pip-audit is not installable through `uvx`, document it instead. Mark the job
      non-blocking, with `continue-on-error`, and leave a TODO.
- [ ] `SECURITY.md` (how to report a vulnerability) and `CONTRIBUTING.md` (setup, checks,
      Conventional Commits, scientific-integrity rules).
- [ ] `docs/privacy-and-data.md`: the data inventory, retention and deletion policy, the consent
      model, and the boundary between educational and clinical use.
- [ ] Web and API checks green, and `pnpm build` green.
